description: The official Mass Mobilization baseline gate remains pending coordinator review; the assigned ccode is provisional. This draft makes no claim to verify the original dataset’s coverage or initial event universe.
required_followup: Coordinator should reconcile this open-web draft against the authorized official baseline before any consolidation or event-status decision.

description: The Bhutanese Jan 15 poultry article (S002) returned a verification challenge; the Jan 28 BBS Paro vendors article (S005) returned a web-tool cache miss and one ordinary exact-URL HTTPS GET failed DNS before HTTP. The February BBS poultry article (S004) remains search-only boundary context. No article body was exposed for S005, so snippets cannot resolve event form or turnout.
required_followup: If review continues, use only a permitted acquisition path or a separate contemporaneous source; do not infer an assembly, its absence, or attendance from snippets. The recorded same-URL request was not retried.

description: Searches included Dzongkha protest/action terms and regional Nepali/Hindi queries alongside English coverage, but open-web indexing did not provide a systematic, comprehensive Dzongkha newspaper or local-archive sweep.
required_followup: A reviewer with Dzongkha fluency or access to a comprehensive local-language archive could test for actions reported only in local-language sources.

description: This is an open-web search, not a complete LexisNexis-style news archive or a verified event census. Search breadth across dates, media, sectors and languages cannot establish that no qualifying protest occurred.
required_followup: Compare against the authorized baseline and any systematic archive/monitor corpus available to the coordinator before treating the month as having no events.

description: No searched lead establishes public-event attendance. The rotating vendor count (S005) and sector workforce estimates in search results are not event headcounts; if additional action evidence emerges for X002 or X004, turnout and the 50-person threshold remain unverified.
required_followup: Use contemporaneous evidence to determine whether a public event occurred and report only explicit attendance or a clearly documented qualitative crowd estimate.
